text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy across services: api, runtime, console, router. Start: 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z. Deploy ID: 38921. Versions -> api: 2.10.0, runtime: r4.2-quant, console: 1.4.0, router: rt-edge. Lockstep enabled. Please ack and confirm your gating scripts are green.

alex: ack. I'll handle API pin + schema check. Will hold if migrations run late.

maya: @alex quick question — are there any DB/raft migrations for API? Thought it's only feature flags.

alex: no DB migrations. Just config toggles and a config flag flip. Plan: 10% canary for 15m, then 50% for 15m, then full.

sam: runtime update looks good on perf matrix (p100/a100). I'm watching quantized path. Need fallback to r4.1 if token error rate > 2% during canary.

jen: console note — breaking change to route UI; we shipped a toggle. We'll keep it off for all but canary users for first 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary windows: api 15m, runtime 20m, console 10m, router 15m. If any service reports `deploy-failed` during canary, automated rollback will trigger across services. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/lockstep-runbook

liam: who is monitoring logs/traces during the window? @nina are you oncall?

nina: I'm oncall for this window. I'll watch SLO dashboards + traces. Alert thresholds: latency > 200ms for 5m, error rate > 1% for 5m. I'll escalate to Zoom if we hit thresholds.

alex: temp router tweak: keep healthchecks to local runtime pool. Patch: ```kubectl patch configmap router -n infra -p '{"data":{"healthPath":"/_hc"}}'``` — ensures canary traffic doesn't affect global health.

sam: runtime smoke command after deploy: ```./smoke/runtime_smoke.sh --timeout 120``` — posts status to #eng-sre when finished.

jen: @maya can you add the UI toggle note to release notes? Small copychange + how to opt-in for canary.

maya: updating docs now, pushing draft to /docs/release-notes/38921.md

alex: pin via ork: `redwoodctl pin service api --version 2.10.0` and `redwoodctl pin runtime --version r4.2-quant`. Do not unpin until we confirm full rollout.

deploy-bot: Circuit-breaker policy set to `grace` during canary. Router will divert to stable cluster on fallback. Automated rollback window is enabled.

nina: I'll trigger manual abort + cross-team Zoom if core metrics degrade. Also will open a dedicated incident thread if rollback starts.

sam: fyi — downstream partner (embedder) requires a header rename. I already sent heads-up to their SREs.

maya: :thumbsup: docs side is green. I'll post release notes to #announcements after canary is green.

alex: running preflight in T-10m: `redwoodctl preflight --check=schemas,traffic-shift,smoke` — will report back here.

deploy-bot: Deploy started (38921) at 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z. Canary phase in progress.
